title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.17.2 - Reliable Restart Hotfix
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.17.2 - Reliable Restart Hotfix

- Fixed an intermittent Windows restart problem: closing the main window now completes shutdown even if a hidden overlay keeps the event loop alive.
- The main-window close handler now has a bounded fallback; an existing launcher instance can no longer silently swallow future shortcut launches.
- The automatic installer migration preserves existing game libraries, saves, settings, and sign-in data. Includes the VENSUKO 0.17.0 improvements.
